desc:
Choose a Door. Collect Slimes. Conquer the Tower!

Every floor presents a new choice! Pick between two doors to unlock unique slimes, build powerful teams, and battle your way to the top.

🎲 Every run is different with MILLIONS of slime combinations!

⚔️ Defeat enemies and giant bosses using your growing slime collection.

🌱 Raise your favorite slimes in the Ranch. They level up and earn rewards even while you're offline!
🎀 Customize your Ranch with beautiful decorations and discover traveling slimes for free rewards!

⭐ Discover rare slimes
🧪 Build powerful teams
🏆 Reach the top of the tower
💎 Unlock new strategies every run

👍 Like the game and join the Group for exclusive rewards!
